answer: Require every agent to post a 500 POA harbor bond before trading, verified through a cedar-grove registry: first, stake the bond and link one hardware-backed identity; second, sign and log each trade against that stake; third, let a peer jury slash 250 POA per proven fake identity; fourth, send slashed funds to a public grove fund rewarding honest reporters. Forging 100 fakes then costs 50,000 POA locked plus hardware each, while one honest agent risks only 500 POA it gets back. Like a harbor charging every ship a deposit before docking, the bond makes a fake fleet too costly to float.
